audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Aatrox 5 of 7 stages while Kayle wins 56.53%, and Level 1 was marked Aatrox even though whys[0] calls it a coin-flip skill check. win[5] (Aatrox) also disagreed with phases[5].side (Skill).
audit.why: Level 1 Aatrox has one Q swing with no rotation stacked and Kayle can trade Q shred; first item is Kayle's Nashor's timing against his still-strong drain, so both rows read Skill.
audit.corrected: Row 0 and row 5 set to Skill in both layers, phases[0].rating raised to 5/10.

audit.why: The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5; Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5; Divine Judgment 160/120/80. Concrete numbers make the engage window actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Grievous Wounds is mandatory even though Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal.
audit.why: Three separate healing sources means chip damage without anti-heal never converts; this is the decisive interaction with Kayle's ramping DPS.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] rewritten to name all three healing sources and give the Oblivion Orb timing.

audit.why: Aatrox W (Infernal Chains) carries a derived grounding flag that Riot's description does not support; no grounding claim made, matching the mirror audit.

edits.before: Through level 10 he keeps out-trading you in melee — his Deathbringer drain on a full Q rotation beats your pre-ranged form, so survive rather than fight.
edits.after: Nashor's lands before ranged form does — his Deathbringer drain on a full Q rotation still heals through your melee autos, so buy Executioner's and farm.

edits.before: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q3 knocks up and it is 14s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — step out of the arc.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes The Darkin Blade — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal — Oblivion Orb by 6.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The third swing knocks up, and his Q is only 6s at rank 5.

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5 — the third swing knocks up, so step out of the arc. - Umbral Dash: 9s at rank 1, his only way out. - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'World Ender's' in wants.foe[2] — false positive, that is the real ability name in possessive form; left alone. Aatrox W grounding flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire and was not used.
